title: Townships of north-east and mid Wales before c. 1840, from tithe maps, the 1841/1851 censuses and the first-edition OS (Welsh historic boundaries, RCAHMW / ArcGIS 2025) — rows released under the Open Government Licence
describe: Townships (trefgorddau), the old subdivisions of Welsh parishes, each shown over the year(s) of the source its boundary was taken from (a tithe map, a census, an estate map or the first-edition OS); records whose own source date is missing or only 'c. 1800' are left out. Only records the dataset itself marks as Open Government Licence are public.

dating.label: township boundary as recorded in its source
